title: Bowel obstruction and ileus in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the bowel obstruction or ileus (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/15/2026
Reason for Admission: Abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting.

Hospital Course:
Pt is a 75 y.o. female with a hx of abdominal surgery. Presented with acute onset abdominal pain and distension. Imaging confirmed a partial small bowel obstruction secondary to adhesions. Pt was managed conservatively with NPO status, IV fluids, and NG tube placement for decompression. Serial abdominal exams showed gradual improvement in bowel sounds and decreased distension. Pt tolerated a gradual progression of a clear liquid diet without further nausea or vomiting. Pain controlled with non-opioid meds. Bowel sounds returned to normal.

Discharge Diagnoses:
Partial small bowel obstruction due to adhesions.

Discharge Medications:
- Famotidine 20mg BID
- Ondansetron 4mg PRN for nausea

Follow-up:
F/u with PCP in 1 week. Return to ED for worsening pain or inability to tolerate oral intake.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, MD
05/15/2026
explanations: Intestinal adhesions with partial obstruction: K56.51 (HCC 78).
